events.body:
## Goal

Harden BLT-Newsletter for production by completing privacy safeguards, migration helpers, QA, and cleanup of the old GitHub Actions/GitHub Issues flow.

## Scope

- Email encryption or final privacy hardening if not completed earlier.
- Import/migration helper for legacy GitHub issue subscribers.
- Bounce/suppression support if SendGrid events are included.
- Compliance improvements such as visible unsubscribe footer and `List-Unsubscribe` headers.
- Security headers/CSP review.
- Accessibility, mobile, dark-mode, browser-console QA.
- Documentation cleanup.
- Deprecate or remove old GitHub Actions newsletter sender and GitHub Issues subscriber flow.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No raw emails are logged or exposed through public APIs.
- [ ] Unknown unsubscribe returns privacy-safe success.
- [ ] Import tool has dry-run and dedupe behavior.
- [ ] Every campaign email has a visible unsubscribe path.
- [ ] Final dashboard works in light and dark mode.
- [ ] Mobile dashboard and public pages are usable at 375px.
- [ ] Browser console is clean for main flows.
- [ ] README/IMPLEMENTATION/TESTING describe the final Cloudflare Worker/D1/Queue architecture.
- [ ] Old GitHub Issues/GitHub Actions sender flow is removed or clearly deprecated.

---
